d: Reporting To: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) / Executive Management
Lead and develop the company's overall marketing strategy to achieve business growth, increase sales, strengthen market share, and enhance brand positioning within the fragrance and retail industry.

The Marketing Manager will oversee brand management, marketing campaigns, digital marketing, advertising activities, and market research while ensuring that all marketing initiatives align with the company's strategic and commercial objectives.
Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and expansion plans.
Prepare annual marketing plans, budgets, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and identify market trends and business opportunities.
Identify target customer segments and develop effective marketing strategies to reach them.
Monitor market performance and recommend initiatives to strengthen the company's competitive position.
Oversee the development and enhancement of the company's brand identity and positioning.
Ensure consistency of brand messaging and visual identity across all marketing channels.
Develop initiatives to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and loyalty.
Lead product launches and develop go-to-market strategies for new products.
Maintain a strong and consistent brand presence across all customer touchpoints.
Lead digital marketing strategies across social media platforms, search engines, and other digital channels.
Oversee paid advertising campaigns and optimize marketing return on investment (ROI).
Develop influencer marketing strategies and strategic marketing partnerships.
Monitor website and e-commerce performance and recommend improvements to enhance the digital customer experience.
Analyze digital marketing performance and optimize campaigns based on data and insights.
Plan and execute seasonal marketing campaigns, including Ramadan, Eid, National Day, and other key commercial occasions.
Coordinate with Sales, E-commerce, and Retail Operations teams to ensure alignment between marketing activities and business objectives.
Develop promotional initiatives to increase sales, store traffic, and customer engagement across retail branches.
Measure campaign effectiveness and assess its impact on revenue and business performance.
Support new branch openings and market expansion through targeted marketing activities.
Lead, manage, and develop the marketing team, ensuring effective performance and productivity.
Manage the marketing budget and ensure optimal allocation of resources.
Supervise advertising agencies, marketing suppliers, and external partners.
Establish performance standards and monitor team and departmental KPIs.
Prepare regular marketing performance reports and present recommendations to senior management.
q: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
8–10 years of relevant marketing experience, including 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership position.
Proven experience in brand management and integrated marketing campaigns.
Strong experience in digital marketing, advertising, and marketing budget management.
Experience in the retail, fragrance, luxury goods, or FMCG sectors is highly preferred.
Proven ability to lead marketing teams and manage external agencies.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and measure campaign performance.
Excellent communication, leadership, and strategic planning skills.
Proficiency in English and marketing analytics tools.
Revenue and sales growth generated through marketing initiatives.

d: The Retail Store Manager is accountable for managing the daily store activities from administrative and operational to offering the best customer experience. S/He manages the team towards driving sales, optimizing stock performance and ensuring a proper level of training and knowledge in the store.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or any other related field.
At least 5 years of relevant experience.
r: Define, develop and implement the store operational plan as per communicated objectives aiming at exceeding sales objectives
Establish sales budgets and targets, cascade to the team and ensure individual and store targets are met
Lead and manage the daily store operational activities to deliver the highest standards of customer service and maximize sales and profitability in line with company’s objectives
Follow up on the appearance and maintenance of the store and staff to meet Apple guidelines and evaluate audit/mystery shopper reports for improvements

Ensure a proper storage, tracking and control of inventory and follow up on the merchandising and replenishment of the store while reporting any inventory related issue/opportunity to the Retail Manager
Optimize the floor coverage and prepare schedules while accounting for vacation plans and days off
Develop and maintain good working relationships with customers and back office departments securing a smooth flow of operations
Ensure the cash management policy and all other policies/procedures are implemented in the store and that cash registers are accurately reconciled
Attend to operational problems namely customer complaints, in coordination with the back office, to ensure an uninterrupted operation and achieve customer satisfaction
Conduct periodic market studies and exchange best practices and recommendations with the Retail Manager and other Store
Prepare and issue periodic reports on store performance and other metrics supporting operational decisions
Work closely with the HR Department on staffing needs and training plans
Ensure that the company’s policies and procedures are implemented/applicable at all times
Lead and coach the team cultivating empowerment and ownership
Develop capabilities and secure a solid succession plan
Conduct regular performance reviews, identify training needs and oversee development plans.
